ggsegCampbell 2.0.0
text: campbell now ggseg_atlas object (ggseg.formats) containing 2D 3D data. separate campbell_3d object removed. Use ggplot() + ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = campbell) 2D plots ggseg3d::ggseg3d(atlas = campbell) 3D plots — object. ggseg.formats now hard dependency (Depends). Package URLs updated LCBC-UiO ggseg GitHub organisation.
